# Sales Compensation Plan FY25 - Archived

## Prior-Year Accelerator

The archived FY25 plan used a 12% commission rate on strategic food and beverage
accounts after manager verbal approval.

The archived FY25 plan included professional services in the commission base for
named expansion campaigns.

## Do Not Use
